show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A selfless man who sacrifices his legendary medical career to become a househusband for his wife and daughter is humiliated, cheated on, and brutally divorced only to lose custody of the child he raised as his own. Years later when he returns as India’s most celebrated surgeon, the very medical genius the world worships. Fate pits him against his past when the child he loved faces a life-or-death surgery—and the family who destroyed him must now beg the man they once crushed to save her life
